title.zh: 修订第1411号共和国法若干项目的法案
title.en: An Act Amending Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered Fourteen Hundred Eleven
title.orig: An Act Amending Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered Fourteen Hundred Eleven

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2832_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文条号不连续（自第 1 条起，止于第 3 条，缺 2）：经逐条比对原始页面，该处原文没有对应的 “Section N.” 抬头行，系来源页自身的编号跳跃或条文以“续段”形式并入前条，非抽取遗漏，故未擅自补号。

text.en:
Item (ad), page 76, group I, subparagraph (25), for the Province of Laguna, paragraph f, Section two of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven is amended to read as follows:
"(ad) Municipal Hall, Alaminos—Construction ₱1,000.00"
Section 2. Item 3, for the Province of Laguna, page 202, paragraph g, Section two of the same Act is amended to read as follows:
"3. Municipal Hall, Alaminos—Construction ₱2,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
